name: resistance band assisted single arm pull up
description: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Lower with control to a full hang.
